reason: H0 never invokes meshopt_generateTangents, so S1's changed behavior is unreachable. Although that entry-point omission existed in S0, the commit materially aggravates it by expanding the valid vertex_uvs_stride domain from a minimum of 12 bytes to 8 bytes, creating a newly accepted configuration and input-layout class that H0 cannot exercise.
evidence: tools/clusterfuzz.cpp invokes meshlet-building and meshopt_partitionClusters APIs, but not meshopt_generateTangents.
tools/codecfuzz.cpp exercises codec and meshlet encode/decode APIs, but not meshopt_generateTangents.
tools/simplifyfuzz.cpp invokes simplification APIs, but not meshopt_generateTangents.
In meshopt_generateTangents, the assertion changes from vertex_uvs_stride >= 12 to vertex_uvs_stride >= 8, newly admitting 8-byte UV records.
The changes to the degenerate tangent fallback and size_t indexing are inside the same completely unreachable entry point; they do not restore H0 coverage.
recommended_action: Add or extend a fuzz target to call meshopt_generateTangents with fuzzer-controlled indexed and unindexed geometry, positions, normals, UVs, and strides, explicitly including vertex_uvs_stride == 8 and degenerate triangles.
